thread:
jamie_sales: Heads-up — ACME Health wants an acceptance-criteria + perf heatmap for the Dedicated POC. They need clear pass/fail, latency targets, and an estimate of priming/burst cost. Can Eng/SRE run this week? cc @lia_eng @omar_sre @tessa_ps
lia_eng: Yep. Proposed 3-phase sweep: ramp, steady, burst. QPS points: 200, 1k, 4k, 8k. Model candidates: redwood-open-7B-quant (fast) or rdl-std-13B (higher quality). Need token distribution and chat vs embeddings split.
jamie_sales: ACME profile: 70% chat (avg prompt 120 tokens, response 300 tokens), 30% embeddings (single short input ~1k chars). Peak concurrent users ~1200 -> ~2k QPS sustained, spikes to ~8k during promos. They asked specifically about cold-start vs 30m-warm priming costs.
omar_sre: For Dedicated we'll simulate KV-cache warm by preplaying prefixes. Warmup plan: 30m linear ramp + 10m steady before measuring. Capture GPU util, queue depth, p50/p95/p99, and token-cost delta with/without quantization. We'll also snapshot system metrics every 10s.
lia_eng: Metrics to include: p50/p95/p99 latency, jitter (p99 - p50), GPU mem high-water, tokens/sec, cost per 1M tokens, sla-fail-rate. Do 3 repeats per QPS point and average.
tessa_ps: Can you include a small harness snippet we can hand to ACME ops? Also need an ops runbook for routing traffic to Dedicated and a short SOW blurb about priming charges.
omar_sre: Quick k6 example to emulate chat:
```bash
k6 run --vus 200 --duration 10m script.js --env TARGET_QPS=1000
```
For embeddings we can use vegeta:
```bash
echo "GET http://dedicated/acme/embeddings" | vegeta attack -rate=200 -duration=5m | vegeta report
```
jamie_sales: On security, ACME flagged audit log retention (2y) and FIPS KMS requirement. @katie_legal any blockers?
katie_legal: FIPS KMS is doable for Dedicated/Private if they bring a customer-managed KMS or we enable our FIPS-compliant KMS in their VPC. Audit retention 2y is fine; costs extra for long-term storage. We'll need a contract addendum (SLA + data retention appendix).
lia_eng: We'll tag ACME traffic and enable token-level logs with PII redaction. Sample config for SRE team below.
lia_eng: config snippet:
```yaml
routes:
  - name: acme-prod
    model: redwood-open-7B-quant
    priming: enabled
    kv_cache: true
    logging:
      redact: true
      retention_days: 730
```
tessa_ps: ACME asked: what's the incremental cost to support bursts to 8k QPS for 15m? Jamie, can we provide a headline delta? Lia/Omar need to quantify GPU-hour burn and egress.
omar_sre: Back-of-envelope: baseline 2k QPS ~ 3 GPU pods. 8k QPS ~ 11 pods. 15m burst -> extra ~8 pods * 0.25h = 2 GPU-hours. We'll produce exact spreadsheet numbers in the writeup (including reserved vs on-demand pricing).
jamie_sales: Can we commit to a Thu run? Ops window 10:00-12:00 PDT OK? @deploy-bot please reserve.
deploy-bot: scheduled: Dedicated stress window reserved Thu 10:00-12:00 PDT — ticket #STRESS-4871 :white_check_mark:
omar_sre: I'll own the execution. After the run I'll post raw logs + heatmap images to this thread and a condensed 1-page summary. Plan to include sections: test-plan, raw-heatmaps, priming-delta, quantization-delta, and acceptance decision.
jamie_sales: Draft acceptance bullets ACME can sign: - p95 latency <= 350ms for chat steady-state at 2k QPS - p99 <= 800ms - error rate <= 0.1% - cost delta for 15m burst <= 3x baseline Can we refine?
lia_eng: If they want the 7B quant model keep p95 <= 350ms. If they test 13B reduce p95 to <=300ms. I'll add memory pressure threshold (GPU mem > 90%) and queue depth cap (requests_in_queue > 50) as failure conditions.
katie_legal: Legal: add clause for service credits if p95 breaches threshold for 3 consecutive measurement windows. Spell out measurement window length in SOW.
jamie_sales: Timeline: run Thu, writeup Fri morning, deliver 1-page heatmap + SOW appendix. Anything missing?
tessa_ps: I'll draft sample answers for their security questionnaire and the KMS onboarding steps. Also include recommended monitoring dashboards and an incident contact list.
omar_sre: After run I'll upload artifacts to /shared/poctemp/acme and post link here. Also will attach the CSV we use to compute cost deltas.
jamie_sales: Perfect, thanks everyone. I'll confirm with ACME infra and send invites. :thumbsup:
lia_eng: :thumbsup: prepping scripts and dashboards now.
deploy-bot: reminder: do not run production traffic into the stress window. :warning:
jamie_sales: Noted. I'll confirm times and deliverables to ACME.
